name: component-structure
description: How to structure React and React Native components and screens in MetaMask Mobile and Extension. Use when writing, splitting or refactoring a component or screen, when deciding where state, effects, handlers, subscriptions or copy belong, or when reviewing a PR that adds or reshapes one. Triggers include many useState calls, useReducer, useEffect with async work, useCallback or useMemo, sub-components in one file, a selector or live-data hook at the top of a large screen, and a list row that subscribes to a whole collection.
